description: Find the official statistic behind a question on a country's economy or society (unemployment, inflation, growth, deficit, debt, wages, housing, crime, immigration, energy…) for 19 countries and the EU, plus related briefings and reform factsheets. Accepts keywords or a whole question, e.g. "youth unemployment Italy", "dette publique France", "why did the French deficit widen". Returns indicator codes and the countries that have a card for each.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (FR, US…) or EU.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

query.description: Words to search, in any of English, French or Spanish.

name: search
title: Search Citoyen
